880-8293-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-8293-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2105-5144-8201-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5144-8201-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5144-8201-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Ephemerate from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Ephemerate from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1981-2415-4506-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-4506-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

141-3899-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-3899-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a charge counter on Spawning Pit.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

401-2403-3944-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-2403-3944-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Moonlit Wake trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

1537-3817-6495-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing Zealous Conscripts, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Zealous Conscripts from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
When Zealous Conscripts enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
Repeat.
1537-3817-6495-6542.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

3703-4247-7084.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Sporemound triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4247-6972-7322.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Big Mother Mouser.
When Big Mother Mouser dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

215-950-2404-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-950-2404-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Fatestitcher.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Fatestitcher any number of times.

2457-2757-6753.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

129-1251-1409-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1491-6006-6218-7315.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2511-6972-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in all graveyards.
2511-6972-7231.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

4316-4871-5220-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4316-4871-5220-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

539-5226-7032.description:
Cast Dai Li Agents by paying its mana cost
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Dai Li Agents
When Dai Li Agents dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dai Li Agents enters, its earthbend ability triggers, causing it to earthbend itself as it is a Forest due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-6797-6863--133.notablePrerequisites: Blue has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-6797-6863--133.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the other Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to the -1/-1 counter it will gain from Blue.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.
628-6797-6863--133.notes: The chosen Dinosaur must not be a Human for the combo to work. Notably, this means you cannot use a creature with changeling for this combo.

338-4186-4268.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4186-4268.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

632-2034-3621-4885-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-2034-3621-4885-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2034-6188-6591--85.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
2034-6188-6591--85.description:
Declare Squall and Fear of Missing Out as attackers.
Fear of Missing Out's second ability triggers, untapping Squall and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fear of Missing Out.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Squall, triggering Squall's second ability, returning Fear of Missing Out from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fear of Missing Out enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to rummage.
Repeat each combat phase.

1329-2178-2981-3661.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-2178-2981-3661.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shield Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

1799-4050-5359-5496.description:
Activate Tomb Trawler by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Threefold Thunderhulk into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating three 1/1 Gnome artifact creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing Threefold Thunderhulk and the Gnomes, adding {4}.
Repeat.

81-1491-2464-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
81-1491-2464-6218.notablePrerequisites:
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
81-1491-2464-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

1479-3478-4288.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-3478-4288.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1116-3240-4268-5670.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1116-3240-4268-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by sacrificing Nether Traitor and paying 1 life.
When Nether Traitor dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a 3/1 Graveborn creature token.
When the Graveborn enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the Graveborn.
When the Graveborn dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Nether Traitor enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat.

5147-5805--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent has lost life this turn.
5147-5805--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it, as well as a +1/+1 counter due to Gev.
The +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters on that creature are removed as a state-based action.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

342-2916-5856.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
342-2916-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Pippin's first ability by tapping it, creating a Food token.
Repeat step 1.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

997-1270-5551.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to defeat Invasion of Amonkhet.
997-1270-5551.description:
Defeat Invasion of Amonkhet
Invasion of Amonkhet triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Lazotep Convert.
When Lazotep Convert dies, it triggers, causing you to exile it, and return it to the battlefield transformed as Lazotep Convert.
Choose to have Lazotep Convert enter the battlefield as a copy of Ojer Taq that is a 4/4 Zombie.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 4.

1641-2034-3263-4192.notablePrerequisites: "Spirit" chosen with Ashes of the Fallen.
1641-2034-3263-4192.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {2}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {1}.
Repeat.

1530-3544-4428-5049.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-3544-4428-5049.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

1821-2837-3297.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token.
1821-2837-3297.description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Phyrexian" on Essence of Orthodoxy to "Cat" or "Dog" until end of turn.
Create a token, choosing instead to create a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste or a 3/1 Dog creature token with vigilance.
When the Cat or Dog enters the battlefield, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste or a 3/1 Dog creature token with vigilance.
Repeat step 3.

1947-5113-5220.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Reckless Barbarian on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Reckless Barbarian from the top of your library by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

1183-4365-4659.notablePrerequisites: Pentavus has at least one +1/+1 counter.
1183-4365-4659.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Pentavite, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

1446-3609.notablePrerequisites: Magistrate's Scepter has 1 counter on it.
1446-3609.description:
Activate Viral Drake, proliferating the charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Repeat step one an additional two times.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization
